title: The Classroom Only Works for One Kid in the Room
summary: CGP Grey argues that a classroom works well only for the one student pitched at the average level, and sketches a future of personalized instruction. It introduces the idea of a Digital Aristotle, a tutor for every learner.
why: Brought up in nearly every discussion of AI tutors and the future of schooling as the original Digital Aristotle idea.
